# Field Definition

## Summary
`FieldDef` is the base class of embedded values — data that lives inside a
card rather than as its own addressable instance. Fields declare their own
`@field`s (compound) or a primitive serialization, and render via the same
format components as cards.

## Invariants
- Contained values serialize inline in the enclosing instance's
  `attributes`; they have no id and no independent lifecycle.
- Polymorphic containers (`containsMany(FieldDef)`) record each entry's
  concrete type under `meta.fields`.
- Primitive FieldDefs (marked with `[primitive]`) serialize as bare JSON
  values and cannot appear in polymorphic containers.

## Example
The address field Spec (`Spec/address-field`) demonstrates this: its
contained `AddressField` example records the entry's concrete type under
`meta.fields.containedExamples`.

## Module
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` — export `FieldDef`.
